value.rationale: The smallest triangle-free four-chromatic graph is a canonical sharp test of recolouring at the minimum palette. Disconnectedness despite all 12,480 states having at least five possible local moves is a nontrivial boundary phenomenon; odd colour renaming/reflection exchanges chambers while palette quotient becomes connected. The exact component size, 17 diameter and degree profile document mobility rather than merely recompute a known colouring number.
